content.accentDescription: Used for the main action, the selected tab, switches and focus rings. It changes as you pick it. Save to keep it.
content.invalidColor: That's not a hex colour. Use 3 or 6 digits, like #ffe54e.
content.tooDark: Too dark to read on the dark background. Pick a lighter colour.
content.backgroundColorDescription: Tints every surface. Only dark colours work, so text stays readable.
content.backgroundTooLight: Too light for the text. Pick a darker colour.
content.imageDescription: Shows behind everything, under a dark layer. Glimmer keeps its own copy, so the original can move.
content.dimDescription: How much of the picture the dark layer hides. More makes text easier to read.
